title: CoMET-V2X: Tracking the Shared Pose Error of Roadside Messages for Asynchronous Vehicle–Infrastructure Cooperative 3D Detection
description:
CoMET tracks the two-dimensional translation shared by all boxes in a roadside message. A causal Kalman filter uses objects detected by both agents to correct roadside-only detections under asynchronous vehicle–infrastructure cooperation. This archive contains the reference implementation, the signed manuscript, the V2X-Seq SPD evaluation protocol, research scripts, result tables and filter traces.
